builtinAdapterHasNoSessionHeader.detail: built-in dsh-llm header seam: absent (only attribution headers; no per-session identity header)

adapterDecision.seam: GenerateOptions.sessionId reaches every registered adapter's stream boundary; ctx.llm.registerAdapter allows a custom route
adapterDecision.builtin: absent (only attribution headers; no per-session identity header)
adapterDecision.decision: alpha.2 keeps provider-side affinity at the session-resume level (codex native sessions are the verified path); shipping an OMC session-affinity adapter would create a new billing/auth surface and is deferred until the host exposes a per-session header interface
adapterDecision.boundary: no OMC adapter injects a per-session header in this release; do not list any protocol as cache-optimised
